design_contract: Create one typed six-Tensor forward op per output dtype with a distinct stable diagnostic namespace/name. Register with installed torch_neuronx.nki_op(mutates_args=()). Its body is exactly F.embedding(ids,weight).to(the same requested dtype). No additional tensor result, clone, alias, cast policy or cache.

Call register_autograd on that returned custom-op object. setup_context saves exactly counts, starts, positions and maximums. Backward calls the unchanged prebuilt build_kernel(enabled=True) result on gradient.contiguous() and those four saved tensors, returning FP32 dW plus five None values. No explicit wrap_nki, second registered consumer, decorator change to protected kernel or global tensor cache.

Kernel factory still returns resident_consumer[2]. Installed Kernel.__getitem__ replaces lnc, automatic wrap_nki_to_torch_hop constructs NKIHOPCaller with [kernel.lnc], and CompileKernel inherits Kernel. These are static contracts, not runtime-branch or exactness proof.

Keep original custom Function route intact as a separately named failure control. Candidate acceptance is reported separately; an expected old-control mismatch is retained rather than relabeled, concealed or used as candidate PASS.
